Gifted: Glass.name: Gifted: Glass
Gifted: Glass.description:
🧬 Glass, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 Raise a door-sized pane, flick blunt beads, grow lenses, shards and plates. Your glass stops fists and pistol rounds until a blow hits its weak point.
📈 Training adds shackles fused to the floor, a lens that focuses sunlight, glazing shut a cracking wall, stairs up a building, shard fans and holding up a falling tower.
⚠️ You always feel the weak point and can shift it, but sudden heat change cracks it.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as the skin at your knuckles cracks and bleeds when you push it.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Glass.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Glass family): Scale: clear glass wells from palms and forearms and sets hard in a second or two as guided; at first about a bucket per scene, up to a door-sized pane. It stops fists, bats, knives and pistol rounds, but a blow on its weak point shatters it; the user feels that point and all strain and can shift it by touch. Bigger structures need learned techniques. Limits: only self-grown glass obeys, though they feel strain in any glass touched. It hides nothing; sudden heat change (fire, then water) cracks it; shards cut unless carefully grown to break blunt. Quirk Strain: light: pane, beads; moderate: shackle, lens, stair; heavy: glazing a failing structure, shard fan; severe: signature fist, holding up a building. Type: Emitter (also fits Mutant). Law: glass left on roads is the user's to clear; unlicensed shards count as weapons.
